items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, but I – it was a very short time.

ctx.x: What about the orchestrators, Gerald Wilson and Marty Paich? Did they come in and work with you before the recording began? Or did Ray just tell them, okay, y’all do the charts of these songs? Do you have any recollection of working with Gerald Wilson or Marty Paich?
Yeah, but I – it was a very short time.
So the charts got written in a hurry.
